name: seedance-mcp
description: Seedance (BytePlus ModelArk) (builder tools): me, generate_image, generate_video, get_job. Every too

platform_mcp_seedance_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SEEDANCE_API_KEY
platform_mcp_seedance_api_key.description: BytePlus ModelArk API key (console.byteplus.com > ModelArk > API keys, ap-southeast-1), sent as Authorization: Bearer. Activate the Seedance/Seedream models first.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /contents/generations/tasks?page_num=1&page_size=1: lists the latest video task; used as the credential check (no account endpoint).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: POST /images/generations {model (required: a Seedream model id or endpoint id), prompt, image (reference URL/base64), size (e.g. 2K or 2048x2048), seed, response_format: url} -> {data: [{url, size}]}: synchronous; URLs are valid for 24 h (all images in raw.data).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: POST /contents/generations/tasks {model (required, e.g. seedance-1-5-pro-251215 or dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128), content: [{type: text, text}], ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1 …), duration (s)} -> {id}; poll with get_job. Text-to-video only: an image_url content entry cannot be added conditionally, so image_url is not sent.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: GET /contents/generations/tasks/{id}: status queued|running|cancelled|succeeded|failed|expired; content.video_url (valid 24 h) when succeeded.
